name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: A deterministic spinning arc: a rounded stroke that turns once every 60 frames at speed 1.
useWhen: A loading indicator on a button, card or status line.
A motion atom that needs to read as 'busy' in a UI mock-up.
avoidWhen: You need a progress bar with a known end: use progress.
The spinner should sit inside a button: use button's loading state.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Spinner size in design pixels (the whole thing is scaled to fit the frame).

variables.label: Color
variables.description: Arc color. Empty uses the theme foreground.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the interaction. Above 1 it finishes early and holds the last state.

variables.label: Transparent background
variables.description: Skip the theme background so the control sits on your own scene.
